decisions.reason: The FAQ's existing same-message MODIFY already records NFT as an added referral-code location, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
Adding the NFT itself as a referral-code display location does not change the already-optional confirmation email or its existing mint-number content.
NFT metadata was already a referral-code display location before the source Event; adding the NFT itself as another location does not alter the metadata requirement.
Referral-code display locations do not change the reward allocation used when a mint has no referral code.
Displaying the mint number on the NFT does not change which asset must be minted and delivered.
The referral-code display-location change does not alter mint price, commissions, founder proceeds, or prize-pool funding.
Adding an NFT referral-code display location does not change badge thresholds or award conditions.
Referral-code display locations do not affect the Transak provider, supported payment methods, or wallet requirements for fiat minting.
Displaying the referral code on the NFT does not alter which sale types fund prize pools or the funding duration.
The referral-code display-location change has no effect on the deferred Discord community server.
Adding the referral code to the NFT display does not change prize announcement or claim behavior.
Referral-code display locations do not affect ticket weighting, winner eligibility, randomness, or verification.
